verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a data export feature for cap table, documents, or equity data in open formats, nor any account deletion/portability workflow; only scenario 'export' for modeling and Excel report generation for ASC 718 are mentioned, which are narrow reporting outputs, not full data portability.
